def parity(x: uint8) -> bool:
    """True when the byte has an odd number of set bits."""
    ex parity(0) == False
    ex parity(1) == True
    ex parity(3) == False
    ex parity(7) == True
    ex parity(255) == False
    acc = x
    acc = acc ^ (acc >> 4)
    acc = acc ^ (acc >> 2)
    acc = acc ^ (acc >> 1)
    return (acc & 1) == 1
